LANDS BELONGING TO THE AUTHORITY:
22.
(I)  Where the  Minister  certifies  that  any land or
interest  in  land  vested  in  a  local  authority  or  a  public
corporation is required by the Authority for any purpose of
the  Authority,  the  Minister  may  by Order published in the
Gazette vest such land or interest in such land in the Authority
with effect from such date as shall be specified in the Order
subject to such conditions if any as may be specified therein.
(2) An Order made by subsection (I) shall confer on the
Authority absolute title to any land or interest in land and to
any buildings and other structures on such land as specified
in the Order with effect from the date specified therein free
of all encumbrances. and no compensation shall be payable
by the Authority in respect of such land or  interest in  such
land or buildings or other structures therein.
